## What it is

A full-stack site for browsing and reviewing movies, with user accounts, review submission and search over a large movie database.

## How it works

- SQL database of 20,000+ movie records, with indexed and rewritten queries
- PHP back end for authentication and reviews
- Responsive front end for desktop and mobile

## Results

Query optimization and better data structures improved feature response time by **30%**.
